title: Remaining-frame inverse Bellman potential is false
statement: The proposed leave-one-out inequality avg_i P_i(I+sum_j Q_j-Q_i)^{-1}P_i <=(I+sum_jQ_j)^{-1} is false. It has an exact six-rank-one-projection counterexample and an exact n=9 counterexample within the genuine RPCD covariance-lift family at A=(I+J)/2.
open_objections: This refutes only the proposed inverse potential, not the RPCD rate conjecture.
